record.question: HbA1c reflects the patient's average blood glucose over approximately:
record.explanation: Answer D: 2–3 months. HbA1c reflects glycemic exposure over the erythrocyte lifespan, roughly 2–3 months, with greater weighting toward recent weeks. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK279046/; https://diabetesjournals.org/care/article/49/Supplement_1/S27/163926/2-Diagnosis-and-Classification-of-Diabetes. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
